title: Mohammad ka gharana
body:
Mohammad ka gharana
Mohammad ka gharana..(4)
Aise hote hai Mohammad ke gharane wale..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
noke naiza pe bhi qur'aan..(2), sunane wale
<<MINI>>
Aise hote hai Mohammad ke gharane wale..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Ye jafao'n ke sile mein bhi dua dete hai
apne qatil ko bhi sharbat ye pila dete hai
ek sajde se ye islam..(2), bachane wale
<<MINI>>
Aise hote hai Mohammad ke gharane wale..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Ek mashkeeze mein darya ko utha lete hai
ye to khud pyaas ko darya ki bujha dete hai
pyaase darya se palat kar hai..(2), ye aane wale
<<MINI>>
Aise hote hai Mohammad ke gharane wale..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Baat ho haqq ki to ye maut se ghabrate nahi
ilm hai inko shahadat hai shehad se sheeree'n
maut ko jeene ke aadab..(2), sikhane wale
<<MINI>>
Aise hote hai Mohammad ke gharane wale..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Apne haatho'n pe uthate hai kabhi khaiber ko aur zara maqtal e akbar ki taraf to dekho
budhe kaandho' pe jawaa'n laash..(2), uthane wale
<<MINI>>
Aise hote hai Mohammad ke gharane wale..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Door tareekiye aalam ko kiya shahe zaman
naam e ahmed ke diye karke dilo'n mein roshan
apne khaime ke charagho ko..(2), bujhane wale
<<MINI>>
Aise hote hai Mohammad ke gharane wale..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Laashe paamaal hui qaidi bane ghar bhi jala phir bhi paigham mohammad ka mitaye na mita
tanha nau laakh ke lashkar ko..(2), harane wale
<<MINI>>
Aise hote hai Mohammad ke gharane wale..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Humne yu meesum o salman baqa paayi hai
chauda sadiyo'n se jo naslo'n mein azaa aayi hai
nasl dar nasl azadaaar..(2), banane wale
<<MINI>>
Aise hote hai Mohammad ke gharane wale..(2)
